definitions.contrast: metadata q99-q10 quartiles pooled across the 199 clips
definitions.crowding: fraction of complete raw-image voxels above metadata q90; intensity occupancy proxy, not a count of individual cells
definitions.depth: GT source-node z divided by true Z extent into four fixed bins; evaluator only
definitions.limitations: Descriptive correlated groups, unknown crop overlaps, no subgroup deployment routing
definitions.temporal: GT consecutive edges within two frames of either temporal endpoint versus interior; evaluator only
